**Welcome to the Zanesville Museum of Art.** Whether you're a first-time museum visitor or a life-long member of the ZMA, here are some tips to help you make the most of your visit.

**When you arrive...**

**Check In**  
Visit the first floor guest services desk to check in, make a donation, inquire about a ZMA membership, or to be placed on our email list.

**Admission**  
Admission to the ZMA is free. Please help us sustain free admission and make a donation when you visit.

## **During your visit**…

**Coats, Bags, and Umbrellas**  
A visitor services specialist will ask you to check coats, backpacks, umbrellas, shopping bags, or any bag larger than 11 x 15 x 6 inches. These items are not permitted in the galleries.

**Gallery Closures**

Please inquire about gallery closures at the guest service desk. The ZMA is always changing to better serve guests.

**Restrooms**  
The ZMA has handicap accessible public restrooms on the 1st and 2nd floors that include baby changing tables.  

**Why You Shouldn’t Touch the Artwork**  
Even the lightest touch can damage paintings, prints, photographs, and sculpture. Please do not touch (even the most intriguing) work of art. Your great-grandchildren will thank you.

**Food and Beverages**  
While food and beverages are not allowed in the galleries during general admission hours, the ZMA has three drinking fountains located on the first, second, and third floors of the museum.

**Photography**  
Photography is permitted for personal, noncommercial use except where indicated. Flash photography, videography, and the use of tripods are not permitted. Please ask at the visitor service desk to find out more about our photography policies. Photography must be conducted without disruption to museum operations or limitation to the accessibility of exhibitions, entrances, exits, doorways, and high traffic areas.

**Accessibility**  
The ZMA is a child-friendly place. Strollers may be used throughout the museum. Please supervise all aspiring child artists while visiting the museum.

We strive to be accessible to all our museum guests. We have two elevators that access all three floors and, should it be needed, the ZMA has two wheelchairs that may be used during your visit.

**Sketching in the Galleries**  
Feeling inspired by the art? Feel free to sketch with pencil in notebooks 11 x 14 inches or smaller. Colored pencils and ink pens are not allowed in the galleries, except during designated classes and in designated areas.

**Lost and Found**  
Have you lost something? Check at our visitor service desk to see if your item was turned in or call (740) 452-0741.

**Wi-Fi**  
We offer Wi-Fi throughout the museum.

**Call Guest Services**  
For further information, please feel free to talk to one of our knowledgeable guest service staff members or call (740) 452-0741.

**Thank you!**

Thank you so much for visiting the ZMA. Enjoy your visit and we hope to see you again soon.
